piprail/piprail.summary: PipRail is an implementation of the x402 "402 Payment Required" standard designed for agent-to-merchant payments. It provides an SDK and MCP server to enable direct wallet-to-wallet transactions across EVM, Solana, TON, Tron, NEAR, Sui, Aptos, Algorand, Stellar, and the XRP Ledger.
highlights: Provides a TypeScript SDK for x402 payments
Includes an MCP server for budget-bound agent wallets
Operates without a backend, database, or API keys

ccf/agentcairn.summary: agentcairn provides a cross-project memory system for coding agents that stores context as Markdown files in a local vault. It uses a disposable DuckDB index for retrieval and supports integration with tools like Claude Code and Codex via MCP plugins.
highlights: Stores durable memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata.
Uses a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search and retrieval.
Integrates with coding agents via MCP servers and host-specific plugins.

sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools.summary: sourcevault-code-tools is a Hermes Agent plugin for searching code, reading exact files, and answering repository questions with file-and-line citations. It connects to a separate SourceVault backend and is described as running on the user’s machine over localhost without source code leaving it.
highlights: Provides slash commands for search, file reads, context, and Q&A.
Supports Hermes CLI, Telegram, and Hermes Desktop.
Includes repo sync and indexed git-history search commands.

Shine8592/china-briefing.summary: China Briefing is a skill for generating structured Chinese news briefings at different geographic scales, from streets to global coverage. It uses search engines according to their roles, cross-checks key facts across two sources, and applies a quality gate before delivering a briefing.
highlights: Supports Chinese and international news searches.
Includes source links, commentary, and action recommendations.
API keys are kept in local configuration or environment variables.

IVRZ-da/agentiker-code-intel.summary: agentiker-code-intel is a Hermes plugin that provides 70 AST-aware tools for code navigation, search, analysis, and editing. It combines tree-sitter, ast-grep, and LSP integration, and lists support for nine languages.
highlights: Includes tools for symbols, structural search, and code analysis.
Provides LSP features such as definitions, references, and diagnostics.
Lists support for C, C++, Go, Java, JavaScript, Python, Rust, TSX, and TypeScript.

IVRZ-da/agentiker-plan-follow.summary: plan_follow is a Hermes plugin for creating and managing structured plans with task dependencies, parallel task groups, and review profiles. It can run verification when a task is completed, commit on task completion, check Git changes against task scope, and manage plan archives and Git operations.
highlights: Supports task dependencies and parallel groups.
Includes six review profiles and verification on task completion.
Provides plan archive and restore tools.

IVRZ-da/agentiker-scout.summary: agentiker-scout is a Hermes plugin combining code and architecture analysis, pattern-based vulnerability scanning, and web research. Its README describes a shared pattern pipeline through which patterns discovered during analysis can be used in bug-hunt scans.
highlights: Provides tools for code and architecture analysis.
Supports pattern-based vulnerability scanning and finding management.
Includes tools for web research and synthesis.

visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes.summary: MongrelDB-Hermes is a memory provider for Hermes Agent that combines dense semantic search, sparse and exact-text retrieval, metadata and range filtering, and near-duplicate detection. It supports native and HTTP-daemon modes, with encryption at rest enabled by default.
highlights: Dense ANN uses HNSW and all-MiniLM-L6-v2 by default.
Sparse retrieval is available without an embedding model.
AES-256-GCM encryption at rest is enabled by default.

Fruxano/fruvisi.summary: FruVisi is a dashboard plugin for Hermes Agent that provides an interactive 2D organizational chart for managing agent structures. It enables functional presets for team lineups, per-agent OpenRouter fallbacks, and kanban task integration via the native Hermes API.
highlights: Interactive 2D org chart using React Flow
One-click functional presets for team lineups
Per-agent OpenRouter fallback configuration

stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge.summary: Hermes Local Knowledge is a reusable Hermes Agent plugin that indexes local artifacts and routes questions to likely sources for inspection. It provides tools to search, retrieve, and traverse artifacts, record lookup feedback, and report local usage; search results are routing hints, not answers, so the selected source should still be read before acting.
highlights: Indexes skills, documents, scripts, runbooks, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
Registers five tools for search, retrieval, traversal, feedback, and usage reports.
Supports local routing feedback and usage summaries.

chenwei791129/hermes-usage-hook.summary: Hermes Usage Hook appends a line showing rate-limit usage to each reply when it recognizes a supported provider from the reply’s model name. It supports Codex and MiniMax, skips the footer if fetching usage fails, and requires the relevant provider credentials.
highlights: Shows usage for available 5-hour and weekly windows.
Supports Codex and MiniMax model names.
Failed usage fetches do not break replies.

ClaudioDrews/memory-os.summary: Memory OS is a local memory infrastructure for Hermes Agent that utilizes a seven-layer system to store and retrieve information across sessions. It integrates SQLite, Qdrant, and Redis to provide structured fact storage, semantic search, and an auto-curated wiki pipeline while remaining compatible with various LLM providers.
highlights: Seven-layer memory system including vector search and structured facts
Local infrastructure using Docker, Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite
Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agent prioritizes injected context

uzairansaruzi/hermex.summary: Hermex is a native SwiftUI app for iPhone and iPad that connects to a Hermes Agent host you run. It lets you start and steer sessions, chat with bots, review workspace files and Git changes, and manage scheduled tasks from your device.
highlights: Streams agent replies, thinking, and tool calls.
Supports session files, Git changes, tasks, and Kanban boards.
Requires you to run and secure your own Hermes server.

sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control.summary: Hermy HQ is a self-hostable dashboard template designed to manage a local Hermes AI agent through a shared Postgres database acting as a message bus. Users can dispatch tasks, review agent plans, and manage memory via a web interface while the agent remains on a local machine.
highlights: Uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents and web dashboards
Features an approval inbox for requests with side effects
Built with Next.js 16, React 19, Prisma, and Tailwind CSS v4

bookunt3d/hermes-agent-fa.summary: This repository contains a complete Persian translation of the official Hermes Agent documentation. The project uses GitHub Pages and includes full support for right-to-left (RTL) text direction.
highlights: Complete Persian translation of Hermes Agent documentation
GitHub Pages site with RTL support

amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile.summary: This project enables the Hermes AI agent framework to run on Android via Termux and iOS via iSH. It allows users to interact with multiple AI personas through a CLI or via Telegram using an API key.
highlights: Supports Android (Termux) and iOS (iSH)
Integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging
Supports scheduled tasks via cron jobs on Termux

InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel.summary: HermesAgent-MultiModel is a local-first AI agent framework that uses Mixture-of-Agents (MoA) orchestration to route tasks to specialized models. It integrates with Hermes and Ollama to run agentic workflows on consumer GPUs without cloud dependencies.
highlights: Implements Mixture-of-Agents via parallel model querying and synthesis
Uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling
Optimized for RTX 4080/5080 hardware

0xarkstar/awesome-hermes-agent.summary: This project is a curated list of resources, tools, and projects for Hermes Agent, a self-improving AI agent by Nous Research. It includes links to official documentation, deployment options, skills, and various community integrations.
highlights: Curated list of Hermes Agent resources
Includes deployment and skill integration links
Links to official Nous Research documentation

zcweah1981/awesome-hermes-agent-zh.summary: A Chinese-language documentation hub for Hermes Agent, organized around getting started, ready-made solutions, domestic deployment, OpenClaw migration, troubleshooting, and reference material. It also includes a separate Personal Agent article series and governance documents describing repository structure and page sources.
highlights: Guides cover setup, deployment, migration, and troubleshooting.
Includes reference material and a Personal Agent article series.
Governance documents explain repository structure and page sources.

Javis603/token-monitor.summary: Token Monitor is a desktop app for viewing live token usage, tool limits, and session details across AI coding tools. It offers multi-device sync, usage history, and breakdowns by tool, device, model, session, or project, with views including a main window, menu bar or system tray, and macOS widgets.
highlights: Supports more than 56 AI coding tools.
Shows historical usage trends and detailed breakdowns.
Offers real-time multi-device sync.

freestylefly/wesight.summary: WeSight is an open-source desktop control console for local AI agents, providing a visual workspace to manage coding agents, tool execution, and file changes. It supports the installation and configuration of multiple agent engines and model providers through a unified graphical interface.
highlights: Supports Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, and Hermes Agent engines.
Includes a runtime dashboard for tracking token usage and latency.
Provides a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.

spacering-net/codeg.summary: Codeg brings multiple AI coding agents into one workspace, displaying their interactions as structured conversations with tool cards, live diffs, and interactive replies. It can import, search, and resume agent histories, support delegation and unattended tasks in isolated worktrees, and run as a desktop app, self-hosted server, Docker deployment, or mobile app.
highlights: Supports 20 built-in agents and any ACP agent.
Agents can delegate work and run side by side.
Includes an infinite canvas for chats, files, terminals, and notes.

Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop.summary: Hermes Agent CN Desktop is a desktop client for the Hermes Agent Chinese community, built with Tauri v2, Rust, React, and TypeScript. It provides a native interface for Windows and macOS to manage the Hermes-CN-Core agent runtime, local processes, and model service configurations.
highlights: Supports Windows and macOS with native window and process management.
Features a built-in Hermes-CN-Core kernel with health check and update capabilities.
Includes UI for chat, memory management, and LaTeX/Markdown rendering.

agent37-platform/minions.summary: Minions is a centralized management interface for Hermes Agent that replaces fragmented terminal sessions with a unified dashboard. It utilizes a Kanban-style board to track persistent agent sessions, allowing users to monitor reasoning, tool calls, and task progress in real time. The system enforces a human-in-the-loop workflow where agents propose completions that require manual verification before being marked as done. Users can also manage scheduled recurring jobs and browse agent-created files through a local-first SQLite architecture.
highlights: Kanban board for tracking autonomous task status and review queues
Live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution
Human-in-the-loop verification for all agent-proposed task completions

hermes-labs-ai/lintlang.summary: LintLang is a local, deterministic static linter for AI-agent instructions and tool interfaces. It scans supported content such as tool definitions, schemas, prompts, and agent files for issues including ambiguous tools, missing bounds, and mixed output formats, and can emit JSON, SARIF, and GitLab Code Quality reports.
highlights: Scans supported agent-facing content in project files.
Findings identify files and suggest specific fixes.
Can generate a GitHub Actions workflow.

runta-dev/clawshell.summary: ClawShell is a security-privileged process that acts as a safety harness for the Hermes Agent ecosystem by protecting sensitive credentials and PII. It functions as a proxy between the agent and upstream LLM providers, swapping virtual keys for real ones stored in a restricted directory to ensure the agent never has direct access to credentials. The system performs Data Loss Prevention (DLP) scanning to redact or block sensitive information in request and response bodies. Additionally, it provides secure email isolation through IMAP sender filtering and supports OAuth-based authentication for providers like OpenAI.
highlights: Maps virtual keys to real credentials stored in protected Unix directories
Scans and redacts PII in request and response bodies via regex
Enforces sender-based email filtering for secure mailbox access

EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio.summary: Ekko Studio is a local-first AI workspace for multi-agent chat, coding, and visual workflows, available as a desktop app and self-hosted web console. It supports Hermes Agent, Ekko Agent, and coding-agent integrations, with shared chats, workflows, files, voice, and platform-channel configuration.
highlights: Supports multi-agent chat with streaming responses and persistent sessions.
Builds executable visual workflows with schedules and approval gates.
Available as a desktop app, npm CLI package, and Docker image.

generalbusiness-ai/keep.summary: keep is a memory tool and reflective-practice skill for AI agents. It summarizes and indexes notes, files, and URLs for semantic, keyword, and graph-based search, and offers command-line and MCP interfaces with local, API-provider, and hosted options.
highlights: Indexes content with summaries, embeddings, and tags
Supports semantic search, keyword search, and graph traversal
Includes reflection prompts and agent-tool integrations

mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne.summary: Mnemosyne is a memory layer for AI agents that stores data in a SQLite database and requires no external services. The README describes integrations through MCP and a Python SDK, with setup guides for several agent platforms.
highlights: SQLite-backed, with no external services required.
Offers MCP and Python SDK integrations.
README lists setup options for multiple agent platforms.

chillerno1/hermes-yt-plugin.summary: This plugin provides a compact YouTube player for the Hermes Desktop client that functions in floating or docked modes. It uses an isolated Electron webview to play watch pages, playlists, Shorts, Live, and embed links without requiring an API key.
highlights: Supports floating or docked pane modes
Saves favourites and up to 50 recent videos
Uses an isolated webview session

topoteretes/cognee.summary: Cognee turns documents, code, and conversations into a self-hosted knowledge graph that agents can search and reuse across sessions. It supports local text ingestion and retrieval without an LLM, with optional LLM configuration for generated answers.
highlights: Builds connected memory from documents, code, and conversations
Supports local ingestion and retrieval without an LLM
Offers plugins and MCP for connecting agents

topoteretes/cognee-integrations.summary: Cognee Integrations is a monorepo of Cognee-owned packages that add persistent memory to agent frameworks, using a knowledge graph and session cache. It also includes chat and editor integrations that connect to a running Cognee server, plus a Claude Code plugin that captures and recalls memory across sessions.
highlights: Integrations are available for frameworks including Strands, CrewAI, and LangGraph.
Chat and editor tools connect to Cognee over its HTTP API.
The Claude Code plugin captures and recalls memory automatically.

Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil.summary: Hermes Brasil reúne skills, guias, integrações e outros recursos em português para a comunidade brasileira de Hermes Agent. O repositório inclui instruções para instalar skills, guias de configuração e uso, e integrações com n8n e WhatsApp via Evolution API.
highlights: Skills em português no formato SKILL.md.
Guias sobre instalação, produção, MCP e autoria de skills.
Integrações documentadas com n8n e WhatsApp.

freehul/progressive-skill.summary: Progressive Skill reduces the size of an agent’s skills index by demoting selected categories to compact count lines and applying a configurable character budget. It uses toolset mappings and recency-weighted skill usage to decide what remains fully visible; the README says the repository is no longer actively updated and is retained as a design reference.
highlights: Includes a Hermes plugin and an agent-agnostic Python decision core.
Demoted skills remain discoverable through skills_list.
Usage scores decay based on recency.

handnewb/hermes-voice.summary: Hermes-voice is a voice-enabled personal assistant designed for Hermes Agent. It operates entirely locally using speech recognition, voice activity detection, wake word detection, and speech synthesis.
highlights: Supports 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro.
Features adaptive turn-taking and barge-in capabilities.
Runs offline with no API keys or accounts required.

MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG.summary: Hermes OTG is a portable, zero-install version of the Hermes Agent designed for Windows 10 and 11. It operates from any drive or folder using relative paths to avoid host system pollution and can run side-by-side with an installed Hermes instance using a separate port and data directory.
highlights: Runs from USB or any drive without host installation or registry writes.
Includes Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes with isolated data environments.
Bundles Python 3.12, PortableGit, and Sysinternals rescue tools for offline use.

jiawood2006/hermes-skills.summary: Hermes Skills is a collection of nine open-source tools designed for Chinese-language agent tasks such as video transcription, document OCR, and text refinement. The project provides scripts for processing Douyin links, generating e-commerce product scenes, and managing long-form writing memory.
highlights: Transcribes Douyin videos to structured Markdown and SRT subtitles.
Removes common Chinese AI writing patterns using a rule-based engine.
Extracts structured data from PDFs and images using macOS Vision.

handnewb/lock-on-absence.summary: Lock on Absence is a Python-based tool that automatically locks a workstation when the user is no longer present. It uses webcam frames and various recognition backends to determine presence and manage workstation state.
highlights: Supports LBPH, SFace, and LLM recognition backends.
Includes a watchdog to lock the screen if the agent fails.
Provides a FAR/FRR measurement harness and SIEM audit trail.

skillseal/skillseal.summary: SkillSeal is a trust system for AI agent skills that uses verifiable evidence and cryptographic signatures to certify them. It employs an evaluator to test skills in isolated Docker containers and a certifying authority to sign the resulting evidence.
highlights: Tests structure, functionality, and security in isolated Docker containers
Produces cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures
Provides a public API for certificate verification and skill submission

handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab.summary: Hermes Cybersecurity Lab is a turnkey ecosystem designed for the Hermes Agent. It provides a collection of 2,077 skills, 131+ tools, and 28 cybersecurity frameworks across eight repositories.
highlights: Includes 2,077 total skills across multiple repositories
Installs 131+ tools for network, forensics, and exploitation
Integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks and standards

EntangledQuantum/Life_OS.summary: Life OS is a personal app where an AI agent creates and maintains habits, schedules tasks, tracks goals, and adjusts plans based on what happened. Users tap to complete items, while data stays in a local SQLite file with no account or cloud sync.
highlights: Habits recur and are scored daily; tasks cover other activities.
Includes an Android client and connects to agents over MCP.
Runs locally and stores data in SQLite.

CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills.summary: This community-maintained skill pack for Hermes Agent provides deterministic path routing and Python runtime selection across Windows, Git Bash/MSYS, and WSL. It enables agents to identify execution domains and verify existing Python interpreters without installing new software or modifying project files.
highlights: Routes file operations using environment-specific path syntax.
Selects and verifies existing project-compatible Python interpreters.
Supports native Windows, Git Bash/MSYS, and WSL environments.

CorsenAI/hermes-connector.summary: Hermes Connector is a Chrome extension that connects a selected Hermes profile and session to tabs you explicitly attach. Hermes can read and control those tabs, including navigating, clicking, typing, and managing tabs within the session’s authorized scope.
highlights: Choose sessions and attach tabs in Chrome’s side panel.
Requires a matching local companion version.
Unattached tabs are unavailable to Hermes.

webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board.summary: hermes-bounty-board is a Hermes Agent plugin for answering customer support bounties or running a bounty board. It uses x402 over HTTP; a business human approves the winning answer, and the submitting wallet receives 85% of the reward automatically. This Python plugin pays on Base.
highlights: Lists open bounties and provides public wallet earnings records.
Lets agents buy ticket context and submit answers for review.
Board creation returns a URL, API key, and USDC deposit addresses.

scavio-ai/scavio-hermes-skill.summary: Scavio for Hermes Agent provides a hosted MCP server for structured data from 31 platforms and an Extract endpoint for URLs. It includes five workflow skills for product research, competitor analysis, price comparison, Reddit sentiment, and YouTube research.
highlights: Connects Hermes Agent to the hosted Scavio MCP server.
Includes five ready-to-use skills.
The README states that an API key is required.

Heybinshao/hermes-appearance-hub.summary: Hermes Appearance Hub adds an appearance panel to the Hermes desktop status bar, collecting theme, language, font, paper-texture, scaling, and conversation-behavior settings. Changes take effect immediately and sync with corresponding official settings; the plugin also offers Ink & Paper and Binshao themes and can restore injected changes when disabled or removed.
highlights: Panel includes 14 themes and three language options.
LXGW WenKai fonts must be installed on the system.
Settings are accessible from a status-bar floating panel.

pomponchik/incontext.summary: incontext is a Hermes Agent plugin that dynamically budgets output space against the active context boundary. It inserts an output cap when remaining space meets a configured reserve or caller-supplied limit, otherwise leaving the request unchanged to avoid truncated responses.
highlights: Budgets output space against Hermes' active context boundary.
Uses a two-stage preflight and middleware policy for token management.
Supports automatic context compression and provider-aware token counting.

conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder.summary: agent-skill-builder creates Claude Code skills and can target the portable Agent Skills core. It provides separate runtime validators, review and migration modes, and a weekly workflow that checks Claude Code frontmatter fields for changes.
highlights: Supports new, review, and migration modes.
Validator reports PASS or FAIL with CI-friendly exit codes.
Project is in maintenance mode; new features are not planned.

conorbronsdon/agent-context-os.summary: Context OS keeps durable project context and workflows in plain Markdown in a Git-backed repository. Its adapters let supported coding agents use shared repository state, while reviewed setup, checkpoint, and close requests produce proposals and receipts.
highlights: Includes adapters for Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, and other agents.
Supports reviewable memory proposals, handoffs, and decision logs.
Integrations are documented and remain opt-in.

conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill.summary: demo-gif is a skill for Claude Code and agents compatible with agentskills.io that creates reproducible demo GIFs and embeds them in a repository’s README. It selects a recording approach for terminal, web app, or library demos, then renders and optimizes the GIF; the project is in maintenance mode, with security fixes but no planned new features.
highlights: Uses vhs tape files for terminal demos and Playwright scripts for web demos.
Optimizes GIFs toward a file size under 8 MB.
Includes Codex plugin packaging and example recording scripts.

33hodl/hermes-startup.summary: Hermes Startup is a local-first skill for Hermes Agent that asks focused questions, offers evidence-labeled business ideas, and helps prepare a small, reversible test. The repository includes the skill, a bounded JSON/stdin adapter, local onboarding and state handling, and a deterministic zero-network runtime.
highlights: Install the skill and use it with `/startup`.
The free journey does not make external writes by default.
Consequential actions require an exact preview and explicit approval.

conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit.summary: agent-memory-kit provides five commands for capturing, recalling, and curating agent memory stored as Markdown files. Its read-only curation pass checks for stale facts and inconsistencies, then proposes evidence-cited diffs for human review.
highlights: Includes rot and lint curators.
Uses Markdown and JSON, with no database.
Memory changes can be reviewed and reverted with Git.

conorbronsdon/agent-skills.summary: agent-skills is a collection of markdown files that teach coding agents specific workflows. It includes skills for session management, code review, state reconciliation, worktree recovery, and skill creation, with installation instructions for Claude Code and other agents. The project is in maintenance mode: it is stable, receives security fixes, and still welcomes issues and pull requests.
highlights: Skills are installed by copying a directory or using the bundled installer.
Includes workflows for code review and session management.
Skills are plain markdown files.

bielcarpi/hermes-live-voice.summary: Hermes Live Voice adds continuous voice conversation to Hermes Dashboard Chat while Hermes handles tasks in the background. It supports OpenAI Realtime, Gemini Live, and local speech on Apple Silicon, with a gateway that keeps task progress and results on disk.
highlights: Voice conversations can continue while background tasks run.
Supports OpenAI Realtime, Gemini Live, and local speech.
Tasks and results persist across voice disconnects and gateway restarts.

allmodels-io/hermes-speech.summary: Hermes Speech is a plugin for Hermes Agent 0.20+ that integrates text-to-speech and speech-to-text capabilities through the AllModels API. It enables conversational setup, voice searching, and streaming audio using Hermes' native provider interfaces and bundled dependencies.
highlights: Requires Hermes Agent 0.20.0 or later.
Uses bundled OpenAI and HTTP clients with no additional pip dependencies.
Supports conversational voice search, previews, and account management.

masterlf/hermes-ai-usage.summary: Hermes AI Usage Monitor is a read-only extension for Hermes Agent that provides telemetry for provider quotas and local token usage. It supports the native Desktop app and Web Dashboard, displaying session history and consumption metrics without reading prompt or message content.
highlights: Tracks official provider quotas for OpenAI Codex, Anthropic, and OpenRouter.
Displays local token counters and session history from SQLite state.
Adds zero runtime dependencies by reusing existing Hermes core components.

sandbaseai/cli.summary: @sandbaseai/cli connects supported AI assistants to SandBase models and data APIs through a local MCP bridge. It also lets users discover and call APIs from the terminal, with browser authorization and a shared daily free-call allowance for eligible data APIs.
highlights: Connects AI assistants through the Model Context Protocol.
Supports discovery and terminal calls for SandBase APIs.
Includes a read-only client catalog command.

Carlo1911/skill-evolution.summary: Skill Evolution analyzes past agent sessions against installed skills and creates structured proposal files for review. Approved proposals can be applied through an evaluation gate; adapters are provided for Hermes and Claude Code.
highlights: Fetches sessions and indexes installed skills.
Proposals are review-only by default.
Evaluation gate supports deterministic, LLM-judge, and regression evaluators.

joeynyc/hermes-hud.summary: Hermes HUD is a terminal-based consciousness monitor and dashboard for Hermes AI agents. It reads data from the agent's local directory to display live information regarding memory, tool usage, project status, and error logs.
highlights: Interactive TUI with nine tabs and four selectable color themes.
Tracks agent growth, git projects, and scheduled cron jobs.
Provides a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes.

Diabloluo/hermes-hud.summary: RelayGlance is a community plugin for the Hermes dashboard that displays local information about agent activity, health, token usage and costs, sessions, skills, scheduled tasks, channels, and incidents. It uses read-only access to Hermes core data and provides a web interface with snapshot and WebSocket updates; the README says it has no outbound telemetry.
highlights: Dashboard tabs cover activity, costs, skills, and incidents.
Reads Hermes core data without modifying it.
Optional alerts can be sent to Telegram and Feishu.

181079342/hermes-memoss.summary: MemOS Memory Plugin for Hermes Agent connects to a self-hosted MemOS instance to provide persistent memory storage. It enables semantic search, fact extraction, and automatic synchronization of conversation turns.
highlights: Supports semantic search and multi-dimensional memory storage.
Includes a circuit breaker for MemOS API outages.
Provides tools for searching, adding, and deleting memories.

FPSUnleashed/hermes-codex-skin.summary: Codex Skin is a plugin for Hermes Desktop that provides a Codex-inspired chat layout. It includes optional themes, adjustable message and activity display settings, history previews, and a task Inbox.
highlights: Includes six optional T3 themes.
Offers settings for composer width and message display.
Native model menus, voice controls, and Queue behavior remain Hermes-owned.

Bandwidth/smartnumbers-hermes.summary: Hermes Smartnumbers receives and archives Smartnumbers conversation transcripts, with tools for searching archived turns and managing post-call reviews. When enabled, it can queue one-shot Hermes cron jobs for transcript reviews and user-configured callbacks.
highlights: Archives transcripts and supports searching transcript turns.
Queues post-call reviews as one-shot Hermes cron jobs.
Supports configurable, independent post-call callbacks.

vshulcz/deja-vu.summary: deja-vu indexes coding-agent session transcripts already stored on disk and provides local search through a terminal interface, CLI, MCP server, and lifecycle hooks. It supports cross-agent handoffs, recovery and attribution of recorded code edits, and context recovery after compaction; the README says it runs as one Go binary without LLM calls or an API key.
highlights: Searches existing transcripts across 52 coding agents
Transfers goals and open work between agents
Recovers recorded edits and attributes lines to sessions

Hiutaky/token-saver.summary: Token Saver is a Hermes Agent plugin that calculates the hypothetical cost of local AI inference based on live OpenRouter pricing. It tracks token usage from local providers like Ollama and LM Studio to visualize simulated savings through a web dashboard, TUI widget, and slash commands.
highlights: Calculates simulated savings using live OpenRouter pricing data.
Estimates token counts from byte length for local providers.
Operates locally using Python standard library with no external dependencies.

JanYork/llm-wiki-cli.summary: LWC is an agent-driven proactive memory CLI that lets AI agents recall, maintain, and evolve persistent, source-grounded knowledge across sessions. It turns curated documents into a durable Wiki with preserved sources, pages, citations, links, indexes, and history, and it does not require embeddings or a vector database. A self-hosted team memory option keeps core memory in local SQLite and Wiki files synchronized through a self-hosted server.
highlights: Agent-driven proactive memory CLI for AI agents
Maintains a source-grounded Wiki with citations and history
No embeddings or vector database required

superagnt/leverage.summary: Leverage is an open set of skills for superagnt, a marketing plugin for Claude and ChatGPT. The skills provide access to live social and web data, people and company enrichment, email finding, a Postgres resource, task agents and schedules, and dashboards that agents can build and share. Packaged skills combine agents, skills, and data flows for specific outcomes.
highlights: Open skills are free to read and fork.
Skills cover social data, enrichment, and web research.
Install with `npx skills add superagnt/leverage`.

pdalinis/incise.summary: Incise is a CLI and agent-tool backend for making precise, byte-preserving edits to Markdown tables, lists, sections, and YAML frontmatter. Callers specify what should change by content-based addresses, and deterministic code handles formatting, boundaries, and the smallest possible splice. It is intended for AI-maintained documentation, Obsidian vaults, Markdown knowledge bases, and local models with limited context.
highlights: Semantic addresses select headings, rows, items, and keys by content

Includes templates for usage, sessions, and office operations.
External connectors require operator configuration.

electricsheephq/caduceus.summary: Caduceus is a Hermes plugin that combines DNA data, Apple Health exports, and health records in a SQLite vault on the user's machine. It provides cited answers drawing on personal data and research, and can create a health brief for a clinician.
highlights: Imports DNA raw data and Promethease reports.
Searches local data and reports locally.
Watches research on personal gene–drug pairs.

100yenadmin/hermes-personal-assistant.summary: Personal Assistant is a Hermes plugin that carries context and follow-through across conversations and workflows. It prepares actions on real sites, presents an approval packet, and stops before the final action until you approve; it also supports workflows for calendars, inboxes, meetings, household administration, shopping, and travel.
highlights: Preserves action records, receipts, and reconciliation state.
Protected actions require workflow-specific confirmation and readback.
Daily Ops and conversation evidence delivery are optional.

100yenadmin/glasses-platform.summary: Hermes Glasses is a Hermes Agent gateway plugin that connects smart glasses and other devices to an agent. Devices can send questions with photos or recordings, receive spoken answers and reminders, and respond to approval requests; devices that cannot keep a connection open can use the documented HTTP routes.
highlights: Pairs devices with a token and connect URL or QR code.
Supports shared Hermes sessions across devices for each person.
Includes a terminal mode for trying the plugin without glasses.

100yenadmin/fish-audio-hermes.summary: Fish Audio for Hermes is a plugin that adds Fish Audio speech and transcription features to Hermes CLI, supported messaging apps, and the Desktop app. It supports speech with delivery cues, voice-library search, voice cloning and design, and transcription; Fish Audio becomes the provider only when none is set, or replaces another provider with confirmation.
highlights: Search and select voices from the Fish Audio library.
Clone a voice from a sample or design one from words.
Live dictation and voice-note transcription are supported.

electricsheephq/heartbeat2.summary: HeartBeat 2.0 is a Hermes plugin that schedules agent turns for reminders, recurring work, roles, and watcher checks. It uses code checks to determine whether work is due before starting a model turn, and provides commands such as `/pulse` to show upcoming work and trigger history.
highlights: Supports timed follow-ups, recurring checks, roles, and watchers.
Watchers can monitor files, processes, URLs, commands, or Hermes events.
Daily turn, message, and optional spending limits are configurable.

electricsheephq/hermes-cloud-file-manage.summary: Cloud File Manager lets you browse, search, upload, and download files and folders on the machine running a Hermes agent from Hermes Desktop. It can preview supported files, lets you review Markdown and text edits before saving, and can optionally browse and import files from Google Drive when the agent is signed in through its google-workspace skill.
highlights: Upload files and folders with drag-and-drop.
Preview files and review text edits before saving.
Import files from Google Drive when configured.

100yenadmin/ai-emotion-chip.summary: Hermes Emotion Chip is a Hermes Agent plugin that lets the agent add delivery cues, such as whispers, sighs, and pauses, to text. It renders those cues for ElevenLabs v4 or Fish Audio and includes commands to inspect cue rendering and check voice setup.
highlights: Supports ElevenLabs v4 and Fish Audio.
Provides offline cue rendering and status commands.
Logs cue words and parameters, not spoken text.

tenuo-ai/hermes-guests.summary: Hermes Guests lets an owner share selected Hermes tools with people using a Telegram bot. Each guest has a separate profile, conversations, and memory, and access requires an owner-approved signed warrant that limits tools and duration.
highlights: Review and approve guest permissions before access is granted.
Manage access, activity, and guest data from your own chat.
Supports Telegram private text chats; group chats are not supported yet.

tubeagentkit/youtube-transcript-skills.summary: An Agent Skill that lets compatible AI agents fetch YouTube transcripts, search videos and channels, browse channel uploads and playlists, and retrieve other video and channel information through the getyoutubetranscript.com API. The README documents installation options, API-key setup, and endpoints for tasks including transcript retrieval, channel search, and playlist contents.
highlights: Supports Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other Agent Skills-compatible tools.
Includes transcript, video search, channel, and playlist endpoints.
API key setup can be guided by the agent.

wiroai/Wiro-Hermes.summary: Wiro-Hermes provides two plugins for Hermes Agent: `wiro-media` adds tools for image, video, speech, music, transcription, and 3D tasks, while `wiro` connects the Wiro AI LLM gateway as a model provider. Both use a Wiro AI API key; the provider offers GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, and Grok models through an OpenAI-compatible API.
highlights: `wiro-media` includes thirteen `wiro_*` tools.
`wiro` adds Wiro AI to Hermes model selection.
Runs are paid from a Wiro AI wallet.

jiangxingfan1-coder/Open-Agent-API.summary: Open Agent API exposes agents through an API, where callers identify an agent rather than a model. The README describes using OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini SDK clients with the gateway, and supports agents with their own tools, persistent context across turns, and approval pauses for sensitive actions.
highlights: Call agents through SDK clients by setting a gateway URL and API key.
Includes an offline sample agent and a quickstart command.
Documents desktop, Docker, and source installation options.

tenuo-ai/hermes-tenuo.summary: hermes-tenuo is a Tenuo plugin for Hermes Agent that uses signed, expiring warrants to limit tool calls and their arguments. Its Hands feature connects a remote Hermes chat to a chosen folder on a Mac or Linux laptop for terminal and file work, with an OS sandbox.
highlights: Warrants can limit tools, arguments, and duration.
Hands supports local terminal and file work.
Hands internet access is off by default.
